findings.note: internal/gateway/templates/pages/account_blocked.templ:28 — `<a href="/login" class="link">` inlines a raw DaisyUI component class (`link`) directly in a page template. ai/htmx-conventions.md §Styling and internal/gateway/AGENTS.md both bind: 'Compose the ui/ kit; never inline a DaisyUI component class in a page/fragment... If a repeated element has no wrapper yet, add one to ui/ rather than inlining the class' (the doc calls a raw inlined class 'a bug'). This is the only occurrence of class="link" anywhere in templates/pages or templates/fragments in the whole repo — grep confirms no precedent. The page this task explicitly mirrors, login.templ, uses a plain unstyled `<a href={ templ.SafeURL("#") }>` for its footer links (no DaisyUI class at all), so the compliant option (drop the class) was already the established pattern one file away. make ui-guard (Makefile:296) passed only because its regex list (btn|card|input|select|textarea|fieldset|alert|badge|stat|table|navbar|drawer|menu) omits 'link' — a guard blind spot, not proof of compliance. tasks.md T1.2's own acceptance note ('only ui.Card is composed, plus the same bare-utility/layout classes Login() already uses') is factually wrong: class="link" is neither a bare-utility/layout class nor used anywhere in Login(). Fix: either drop the class (matching Login()'s footer-link precedent exactly) or add a ui.Link wrapper if a styled back-link is intentionally wanted.

openspec/changes/RM34-gateway-block-inactive-login/tasks.md — T6.1 and T7.6 checkboxes are left unchecked ([ ]) even though the corresponding work is actually done (internal/gateway/AGENTS.md carries the dated RM34 entry; T7.1's note confirms openspec validate --strict was run and passed) and progress.json's tasks[] records T6.1 as status:"done".
